blocks.text: A transaction on InnoDB can undo row changes before they are committed. Keep setup DDL outside the transaction you are testing.

Use MariaDB 10.11+ with its mariadb client in an empty practice database. These dialect-specific examples do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Keep the sample database separate from real records.

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ROLLBACK` cancels the applicable uncommitted changes. It cannot undo an earlier committed transaction.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: The final count is 0 after the insert is rolled back.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Other storage engines can have different transaction support. This sample explicitly uses InnoDB.
